name: dspy-evolution
description: Exotic: GEPA-driven self-evolution for DSPy.ts programs. Run multi-generation reflective Pareto evolution against a held-out benchmark — each generation reflects on the weakest cases, mutates the program's instructions (and, optionally, swaps modules / restructures the Pipeline), persists the non-dominated frontier to AgentDB, and resumes from it next run. Includes the `evolution-coordinator` agent and MCP tools to evolve / benchmark / inspect frontiers.
